description.text:
Do you want to play a key role in building a modern data platform that enables analytics and AI at enterprise scale? We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep Databricks expertise to join a high-performing platform team. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with platform development, architecture, and technical enablement in an environment where you'll have a real impact on both technology and ways of working.
About the Role As part of a central platform team, you will help build and evolve a modern cloud-based data platform used by multiple development teams. This is not a traditional Data Engineer role focused solely on pipelines—you will contribute to creating reusable frameworks, improving the developer experience, and enabling other teams to succeed.
Your responsibilities will include:

Developing and improving data ingestion and data product frameworks.


Designing and implementing scalable data governance and access control using Unity Catalog.


Acting as the go-to Databricks expert, supporting and coaching development teams.


Evaluating and introducing new Databricks capabilities to continuously improve the platform.


Contributing to a scalable, secure, and user-friendly platform for data, analytics, and AI.


 
We Believe You Have

Several years of experience working as a Data Engineer with Databricks in production environments.


Strong expertise in Apache Spark, Python, and SQL.


Experience with Unity Catalog, data governance, and modern data platform architecture.


A background in building reusable frameworks and platform components.


The ability to collaborate with engineers, architects, and stakeholders across different teams.


Strong communication skills and a passion for knowledge sharing and technical coaching.


Experience with AWS, CI/CD, Databricks Asset Bundles, Lakeflow, Auto Loader, and Databricks certifications is considered an advantage.
Who You Are You're a collaborative and curious engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping others succeed. You take ownership, think long-term, and thrive in environments where you can influence both technical direction and engineering practices.

What We Offer

A key role in shaping a modern enterprise data platform.


The opportunity to work with the latest technologies in Databricks, cloud, data engineering, and AI.


A collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues and short decision-making paths.


Significant technical ownership and the opportunity to make a lasting impact.



 Interested in learning more? Get in touch with us. We'd love to hear from you and tell you more about the opportunity to join an organization where technology, continuous learning, and innovation are at the heart of everything we do. This recruitment is managed by EdZa Group. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please don't hesitate to contact tyra.nguyen@edzagroup.se.

description.text:
På uppdrag av vår kund söker vi nu en Data Engineer som vill vara med och bygga framtidens dataplattformar hos några av Sveriges mest spännande företag och organisationer. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med moderna teknologier inom Microsofts dataekosystem och bidra till lösningar som skapar affärsvärde, stärker verksamheter och förbättrar människors vardag.

Om verksamheten Vår kund erbjuder en miljö där teknik, innovation och kompetensutveckling står i centrum. Här arbetar erfarna specialister tillsammans för att lösa komplexa utmaningar och skapa långsiktigt värde genom moderna data- och analyslösningar.
Kulturen präglas av kunskapsdelning, samarbete och ett starkt fokus på personlig utveckling. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med moderna teknologier, utveckla din kompetens och bidra till projekt som gör verklig skillnad för verksamheter och användare.

Ditt framtida team Du blir en del av ett team med hög teknisk kompetens inom data engineering, analytics och dataplattformar. Teamet arbetar nära både tekniska och verksamhetsnära intressenter för att designa och implementera skalbara lösningar som möter dagens och morgondagens behov.
Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med andra specialister där erfarenhetsutbyte, problemlösning och kontinuerligt lärande är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Om rollen Som Data Engineer kommer du att ha en central roll i utvecklingen av moderna dataplattformar och dataflöden. Du arbetar med att designa, bygga och optimera lösningar som möjliggör effektiv hantering, bearbetning och analys av stora datamängder.
Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

Utveckla och vidareutveckla moderna dataplattformar i molnbaserade miljöer.


Bygga och optimera data pipelines för insamling, transformation och lagring av data.


Delta i migrering och modernisering av befintliga datalösningar.


Implementera datamodeller och arkitekturprinciper för skalbara lösningar.


Säkerställa datakvalitet, prestanda och långsiktig förvaltning.


Samarbeta med utvecklare, analytiker, arkitekter och verksamhetsrepresentanter för att skapa affärsvärde genom data.


Bidra till teknisk utveckling och kunskapsdelning inom teamet.



Din profil Vi söker dig som har ett starkt intresse för data, teknik och problemlösning och som trivs med att arbeta i komplexa tekniska miljöer.
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet som Data Engineer eller i en liknande roll.


Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.


Erfarenhet av moderna dataplattformar och molnbaserade datalösningar.

description.text:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  
We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Data Engineer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? 
The role 
The Ad Platform Solutions team sits within Viaplay Digital Ad Product, bridging commercial priorities and technical delivery in Viaplay. You will be joining a small, growing team where your work connects directly to how the sales organisation operates every day.
As our new Data Engineer, you will play a central role in developing and improving the data infrastructure that powers ad sales across all Viaplay markets. We’ve built a solid foundation that supports our operations today, and we’re now looking for someone to take ownership of it - improving and strengthening what’s already in place, while also influencing architecture and shaping how the platform evolves.
This is a hands-on engineering role. In a small team, you will work across the full data lifecycle - from pipeline development and orchestration to data modelling, ensuring the right data reaches the right people. Your day-to-day will include: 
• Building and maintaining data pipelines that power ad sales reporting and operations across Sweden, Norway, and Denmark
• Structuring and modelling data so it is clean, consistent, and genuinely useful to the business
• Identifying and resolving issues in existing pipelines, reducing manual work and improving reliability
• Translating needs from stakeholders into solid technical solutions
• Contributing to architectural decisions as the platform evolves 
We actively use AI-assisted tools as part of our development workflow to improve efficiency and speed up delivery. We expect engineers to use these tools effectively, while critically evaluating outputs and maintaining full ownership of the systems they build.
What we’re looking for 
We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: 
• Solid, production-level data engineering experience - you have done this before and know what good looks like
• Strong skills in Python and/or C#, with confident SQL and hands-on database experience, relational databases such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
• Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, particularly in Azure environments.
• Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using orchestration tools (such as Airflow or Meltano), along with a solid understanding of data warehouse principles (e.g. dimensional modelling, data quality, and performance optimisation)
• Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude) in a development workflow
• Comfortable working autonomously in a small team, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive work forward without much hand-holding 
It’s a bonus if you have: 
• Experience with ad sales, digital advertising data, or media industry systems
• A can-do attitude, sense of humor and the ability to work humbly with others. 
What we offer you
We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.   Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.   A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. 
Hit play today 
If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.  
Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

description.text:
På Knowit Core Malmö söker vi en senior profil som vill kombinera teknisk spets med verklig påverkan. Här får du arbeta nära kunder, driva viktiga teknikval och vara med och designa, bygga och vidareutveckla moderna data-plattformar baserade på Microsoft Fabric, Azure och närliggande molntjänster.
Det här är rollen för dig som vill ha en tydligt senior position där du både bygger själv och leder tekniska vägval – med stor möjlighet att påverka såväl kundernas utveckling som vår fortsatta satsning inom Data & AI.
Om rollen
Som Lead Data Engineer / Data Architect får du en central roll i kunduppdrag där moderna dataplattformar står i centrum. Du kombinerar teknisk spets med affärsförståelse och hjälper kunder att gå från ambition och målbild till hållbara, skalbara lösningar som skapar verkligt värde.
Du arbetar nära verksamhet, tekniska beslutsfattare, arkitekter och utvecklingsteam och blir en viktig rådgivare i frågor som rör arkitektur, skalbarhet, säkerhet och långsiktig utveckling. Här får du möjlighet att påverka på riktigt – både strategiskt och tekniskt.
Du kan till exempel arbeta med greenfield-plattformar, modernisering av befintliga datamiljöer, Fabric-adoption, lakehouse/data warehouse-design, integrationslösningar och AI-redo datagrund. Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera hands-on leverans med rådgivning, arkitektur och tekniskt ledarskap i uppdrag som ligger högt på kundernas agenda.

Vem är du?
Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av att bygga moderna dataplattformar i molnet och att du idag arbetar som Senior Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer eller Data Architect. Du är trygg i tekniken, van att diskutera lösningsdesign och målarkitektur med kunder och beslutsfattare, och motiveras av att få använda din kompetens där den gör verklig skillnad.
Du trivs i konsultrollen, gillar att ta ansvar från idé till leverans och drivs av att skapa robusta, genomtänkta lösningar som kunderna verkligen får nytta av. Samtidigt uppskattar du att arbeta i en miljö där hög teknisk nivå kombineras med samarbete, kunskapsdelning och entreprenörsanda.
Det här ser vi som viktigt för rollen
· Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa och bygga moderna dataplattformar i Microsoft Fabric, eller stark närliggande erfarenhet från Azure-baserade dataplattformar som Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory eller Databricks
· God förståelse för dataarkitektur, datamodellering och design av lakehouse- och data warehouse-lösningar
· Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL samt erfarenhet av Python, PySpark eller liknande för transformation och automatisering
· Erfarenhet av ETL/ELT, pipelines, integrationer och DataOps/CI/CD i molnbaserade miljöer
· Förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar, leda vägval och samarbeta nära både kund och utvecklingsteam
· God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska
Meriterande erfarenheter
· Microsoft Purview, data governance och lineage
· Snowflake, dbt eller andra moderna transformationsramverk
· AI-plattformar, MLOps eller lösningar som möjliggör generativ AI
· Azure Landing Zones, säkerhetsmönster och bredare cloud architecture-erfarenhet
· Power BI och förståelse för hela kedjan från dataplattform till konsumtion
Erfarenhet av Power BI är alltså meriterande, men rollen är i första hand engineering- och plattformstung snarare än rapport- och visualiseringsfokuserad.
Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trygg i dialogen med både kunder och kollegor. Du gillar att dela med dig av din kunskap och trivs i miljöer där kvalitet, samarbete och teknisk utveckling går hand i hand.
AI och data hos Knowit Core Malmö
Hos Knowit Core Malmö ser vi AI som en naturlig del av moderna dataplattformar och data engineering – och som en möjlighet att skapa nästa generations lösningar för våra kunder.
Vi bygger lösningar där robusta datapipelines och moderna dataplattformar möjliggör generativ AI, avancerad analys och smartare beslutsstöd. För oss handlar AI inte om hype, utan om att skapa konkret affärsvärde genom rätt dataarkitektur, rätt teknikval och stark genomförandekraft.
Du behöver inte vara expert inom AI idag, men vi tror att du är nyfiken på hur AI och data engineering tillsammans förändrar framtidens system och plattformar.
Vi erbjuder
• Möjlighet att arbeta i strategiskt viktiga kunduppdrag där moderna dataplattformar, integrationer och AI står högt på agendan • En tydligt senior roll med stor påverkan på teknikval, arkitektur, leverans och utvecklingen av vårt erbjudande inom Data & AI • En vardag där du får kombinera hands-on utveckling med rådgivning, arkitektur och tekniskt ledarskap • Möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor med hög teknisk nivå och stark vilja att utvecklas tillsammans • Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar, kunskapsdelning och uppdrag som utmanar och utvecklar dig • Ett starkt team i Malmö, korta beslutsvägar och en kultur präglad av frihet under ansvar, samarbete och entreprenörskap
Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generations dataplattformar, ta en nyckelroll i strategiskt viktiga kunduppdrag och samtidigt vara med och forma framtidens Data & AI-erbjudande?
Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan till Knowit Core Malmö.

Vi söker en erfaren Data Engineer eller Backend Developer som vill arbeta med moderna dataplattformar, skalbara datapipelines och hållbara tekniska lösningar.

I rollen får du kombinera tekniskt djup med affärsförståelse och arbeta nära verksamheter för att omsätta behov till robusta data- och integrationslösningar. Du blir en del av en miljö där kvalitet, kunskapsdelning och teknisk utveckling står i centrum.

Här värdesätts tekniskt hantverk, långsiktigt tänkande och förmågan att skapa lösningar som håller över tid. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med moderna tekniker inom data engineering, cloud och AI-stödda utvecklingsprocesser samtidigt som du utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor.

description.text:
In this role, you will work with our customers on various data engineering projects. This role
is perfect for those with a good foundation in data engineering, and a passion for operational
excellence in data management and analytics. You will design, build, and maintain efficient,
scalable data pipelines and work closely with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to
deliver customized data solutions that drive impactful business decisions.
Develop and manage scalable data pipelines, ensuring efficient and reliable data flows.
Implement processes and solutions to improve data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
Create scripts and tools to automate repetitive tasks, improving efficiency and reducing manual work.
Build and maintain data integrations, including file, messaging, and API-based systems.
Develop data models tailored to meet business requirements.
Contribute to implementing infrastructure as code solutions.
Collaborate with data scientists, architects, and software developers to support the
creation of data architecture and governance models.
Enhance the performance of existing data pipelines, optimizing queries and indexing for faster data retrieval.
Implement security measures to protect data from unauthorized access.
Ensure compliance with data governance policies and regulatory requirements, maintaining documentation and data lineage.
Monitor cost efficiency and identify areas for optimization.
You are passionate about building data products and enabling data-driven decisions.
You enjoy sharing knowledge and learning new things in the data, analytics & AI area.
You want to develop and maintain robust, scalable data and analytics systems.
You have the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Fluent in English both written and verbal.
You are eager to learn and have a basic understanding of working with data sets
You are gaining experience with ETL workflows and excited to improve your skills in
streamlining these processes.
You have a foundational knowledge of big data concepts, cloud technologies, and data modeling.
Your skills in SQL and Python are strong, with a focus on writing efficient queries.
You are gaining hands-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google
Cloud and are keen to expand your knowledge.

description.text:
Vill du ta ditt konsultande till nästa nivå hos Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare? Vi vet vad du tänker. Du har hört det förut. Men tro oss, det har du inte. Vårt körsbär på konsulttårtan är något annat. Sök jobbet och smaka själv!
Rollen
Vi söker just nu flera Data Engineers som vill vara med och bygga moderna dataplattformar och AI-drivna lösningar som faktiskt skapar affärsvärde. Vi söker dig som har 3+ års erfarenhet av rollen som Data Engineer. Vi har både behov för seniora Data engineers och mediora, så tveka inte att söka in. 
I rollen kommer du arbeta med teknologier som Databricks, Azure och Azure Data Factory, samt utveckla lösningar inom BI, data pipelines och AI/ML-baserad analys. Fokus ligger på att bygga skalbara dataplattformar och smarta datalösningar som hjälper organisationer att fatta bättre beslut.
Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av exempelvis:

Databricks


Azure / Azure Data Factory (ADF)


Data engineering och data pipelines


BI / datavisualisering


Modern dataarkitektur


För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och gillar att använda data och AI för att lösa verkliga affärsproblem.
Krav: Du talar svenska, norska eller danska.
Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan, så bokar vi upp ett möte i närtid! 
Bara det bästa åt de bästa – vår personalfilosofi
Castra är en konsultgrupp inom IT och Management. Eller ja, en elite squad kan man säga. Vi samlar de vassaste och mest erfarna konsulterna, helt enkelt för att det är hos oss de får ut max i både kapacitet och livskvalitet. Vi är verksamma inom Systemutveckling, IT-infrastruktur, IT-styrning & Ledarskap samt IT-säkerhet.
Vi är utsedda till Sveriges- och Europas bästa arbetsplats, på riktigt! Det låter lite skrytsamt, men det är faktiskt inte vi som sagt det. Castra har sedan 2017 blivit certifierad av Great Place to Work, en utmärkelse som är helt baserat på medarbetarundersökningar. Vi har de senaste tre åren blivit utnämnda till Sveriges Bästa Arbetsplats för stora bolag och nu senast kammade vi även hem förstaplatsen bland Europas Bästa Arbetsplatser. Som grädde på moset är vi även ett Gasell- och Karriärföretag!
På Castra tror vi på frihet, utveckling och gemenskap. Du som konsult styr själv vilka uppdrag du tar, när du jobbar, om du vill levla upp någon kompetens och hur och mycket lön och semester du tar ut. Att du får bygga din egen logga är bara en bonus! Trodde du det var allt? Då trodde du fel. Stöd av bra chefer, aktiviteter, kompetent och snabbfotad säljstyrka, möjlighet till delägarskap, stora möjligheter att påverka bolagets framtid och härliga kollegor – listan på vad som gör Castra till en fantastisk arbetsplats kan göras lååång. Möjligheterna bra nära oändliga. Win för alla parter, säger vi.
Castra har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro, Jönköping och Sundsvall.
Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss på castra.se/konsulterbjudande/
Har vi lyckats väcka din nyfikenhet?
Sök direkt via länken eller hör av dig till Charlotta Ljung på Charlotta.Ljung@castra.se

31019447.headline: Senior Data Engineer till Knowit i Göteborg

description.text:
Forma framtidens datadrivna lösningar i molnet. Är du en erfaren Data Engineer som vill arbeta nära tekniken och bygga robusta dataplattformar i moderna molnmiljöer? Hos Knowit i Göteborg får du möjlighet att ta ett tekniskt ledarskap i uppdrag där kvalitet, skalbarhet och affärsvärde står i centrum – tillsammans med några av Sveriges mest datatunga myndigheter och företag.
Om rollen som Senior Data Engineer på Knowit
Som Senior Data Engineer hos oss i Göteborg arbetar du med att designa och utveckla avancerade datalösningar i molnet. Du kommer arbeta med moderna principer inom datamodellering, semantic layers och data governance för att skapa robusta och framtidssäkra dataplattformar. Du tar ansvar för arkitekturval, implementation och optimering av pipelines, och fungerar som en teknisk förebild i teamet. Våra uppdrag spänner över både offentlig och privat sektor, där du är med och skapar lösningar där data blir en strategisk tillgång och en central del av verksamheten.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:
Designa och implementera skalbara dataplattformar i moln (Azure, AWS, GCP)


Bygga och optimera datapipelines med Python och DBT


Säkerställa hög datakvalitet, prestanda och robusthet i komplexa system


Driva tekniska beslut och bidra till best practices inom data engineering


Stötta team och kunder i arkitektur- och designfrågor

Vår teknikstack / verktyg och metoder
Python, SQL


Dagster, Airflow


DBT, Docker, Kubernetes


Snowflake, DataBricks, BigQuery


Molnplattformar: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud


CI/CD och Infrastructure as Code


Vi uppmuntrar ständig teknisk utveckling och du får vara med och påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt i våra kunduppdrag.
Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig med minst 7 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, som är redo att ta ett större ansvar i team och leveranser. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar, Python och DBT, och är van vid att arbeta nära både teknik och affär.
Du är trygg i att leda tekniska diskussioner, fatta beslut och stötta andra. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och trivs i en kultur där samarbete och lärande står i fokus. Erfarenhet av AI och datadrivna organisationer är ett plus.
Vad erbjuder Knowit i Göteborg?
Hos oss får du arbeta i uppdrag som gör verklig skillnad – från samhällsviktiga initiativ inom offentlig sektor till innovativa lösningar i industrin. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med välkända organisationer och myndigheter i en miljö där teknik, lärande och balans står i fokus. Vi erbjuder flexibilitet, ett centralt kontor i Göteborg och en kultur präglad av kunskapsdelning kultur, innovation, hållbarhet och en sund balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Vi har ett modern kontor i centrala Göteborg där vi ofta har aktiviter så som AW, föreläsningar och hackathons.
Är du redo att ta nästa steg som Senior Data Engineer?
Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av Knowit i Göteborg!

description.text:
Har du ett öga för detaljer och drivs av att omvandla data till insikter som bidrar till affärsutveckling? Är du analytisk, nyfiken och vill vara med och göra skillnad i en dynamisk och samhällsviktig verksamhet? Då kan du vara den vi söker! 

Du, vi och jobbet 

Du blir en del av ett kompetent och engagerat team inom Business Performance & BI, som ingår i Group Business Control. Funktionen arbetar med målstyrning, strategisk affärsanalys samt utveckling av modeller och riktlinjer för tjänste- och kundlönsamhet. Vi befinner oss i en spännande förändringsfas, vilket skapar goda möjligheter både i rollen och för din framtida utveckling. Du rapporterar till BI manager under Head of Business Performance & BI.

Vi söker en engagerad och lösningsorienterad analytiker som vill vara med och driva vår transformationsresa framåt. I rollen hanterar och analyserar du data, utvecklar automatiserade lösningar och använder BI-verktyg för att skapa beslutsunderlag som stärker affären. Du arbetar nära olika delar av organisationen och bidrar till att våra projekt levererar värde och effektivitet samt stödjer verksamheten i att fatta välgrundade beslut. Genom ett proaktivt stakeholder management bidrar du till att våra projekt levererar kvalitet, effektivitet och välgrundade beslutsunderlag.

Vad kommer du att göra? 

I rollen kommer du att kombinera affärsförståelse, analys och teknisk kompetens för att utveckla datadrivna lösningar och förbättra våra arbetssätt. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara:

Hantera, modellera och analysera stora datamängder för att identifiera trender och affärsmöjligheter.
Följa upp resultat och föreslå förbättringar för att optimera affärsprocesser.
Utveckla och implementera automatiseringslösningar för ökad effektivitet inom verksamheten.
Skapa datamodeller och använda BI-verktyg för att bygga rapporter och dashboards som stödjer affärsbeslut.
Driva och leda projekt från start till mål, med fokus på kvalitet och affärsvärde.
Samarbeta med kollegor i olika länder och funktioner för att förstå behov och leverera datadrivna lösningar.


Vem söker vi? 

Du är analytisk och har förmåga att bryta ner komplexa datamängder till tydliga insikter. Du trivs med att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta lösningar och driver dessa genom hela projektets livscykel. description.text:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
We are seeking experienced Lead Data Analysts to drive the data and analytics agenda across one of our Areas within Commercial. In this role, you’ll lead complex, high-impact analytical initiatives and represent data analytics in the wider Commercial domain, from shaping the data roadmap and setting KPIs to delivering production-ready solutions and strategic recommendations that guide key business decisions. You’ll ensure the timely delivery of high-quality work while fostering a collaborative and innovative culture across the team and beyond. 
In addition to the responsibilities above, your role will include: 
Act as a trusted advisor to senior business and product leaders, shaping strategy and priorities through insights on customer behaviour, commercial and product performance. 
Envision, articulate and own a data and analytics roadmap that aligns with organisational goals and future tech trends. 
Lead the KPI-setting work for your area and beyond, ensuring measurement frameworks and event tracking align with and contribute to strategic business goals. 
Lead complex, high-importance analytics projects end to end, from exploratory analysis and proof of concept to A/B testing, productionising, roll-out and scaling, ensuring on-time delivery and high-quality standards. 
Tackle difficult business problems where no good solution exists yet, using advanced methods such as quasi-experiments when a complex roll-out makes standard testing impossible. 
Implement new use cases, including AI: explore large datasets, test new algorithms and prompt engineering approaches, evaluate model outputs and ensure solutions are production-ready and scalable. 
Work closely with solution architects and data engineers on the data architecture and data modelling for your domain, ensuring data quality, accessibility and reliability. 
Stay hands-on with SQL, Python and tools such as BigQuery, dbt, Looker and Power BI to explore, model and visualise data and communicate insights. 
Lead other data analysts on complex projects and mentor colleagues within and beyond your area, championing best practices through demos, documentation and walkthroughs, including coaching on data storytelling. 
Promote a data-driven culture and act as a leader in the analytics Community of Practice within Commercial and across H&M Group, fostering shared learning, collaboration and continuous improvement. 



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
You’ll join a global, cross-functional team committed to delivering exceptional digital experiences through close collaboration, user-centric design and continuous iteration. As Lead Data Analyst, you’ll represent data analytics for your area and partner closely with other product teams within the global digital experience organisation, data and tech colleagues such as solution architects and data engineers, as well as senior business stakeholders and decision-makers. 


WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with… 
Experience from product or business analysis, customer or commercial analytics, management consulting or data engineering, including leading complex, high-impact analytics initiatives.
Proficiency in SQL and good working experience with Python or R, git, dbt and cloud analytics environments such as GCP or Databricks.
Previous experience within ecommerce, retail, fashion or tech product-driven companies.
Academic degree within Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering (or similar), or equivalent working experience.
Expertise in data visualisation tools and techniques, e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio.
Strong theoretical and applied knowledge of statistics and expertise in at least one advanced analytics field, such as experimentation, quasi-experiments or backtesting.
Proven ability to independently take a solution from A to Z exploratory analysis, proof of concept, A/B testing, stakeholder alignment, productionising, roll-out and scaling.
Extensive knowledge of data product development and a good understanding of AI, data science and data engineering work.
A proven track record of delivering innovative, impactful data and insights that drive key business decisions at a senior level.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders across different competences (Commercial Leads, eCommerce Managers, Product Managers, Developers, Designers, Data Engineers etc.) in a large matrix organisation.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to lead and influence decision-making on large, key initiatives.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to foster a positive and collaborative team environment, also outside your own domain.

And people who have… 
Experience working in agile, iterative product development environments.
A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve conflicts constructively and build alignment across areas and stakeholders.
Curiosity and the drive to spot, explore and test emerging methods and technologies relevant to H&M, and to lead their adoption.
A passion for data advocacy, automation and continuous improvement, always looking for ways to raise data literacy and enhance the team’s ways of working.

 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

description.text:
Job Description
Do you want to combine people leadership with hands-on analytical expertise and help strengthen how data and insights support marketing decisions?
We are looking for a Data Analyst Manager to join Marketing Insights & Steering within H&M’s Global Marketing Domain. As our area continues to grow, we are strengthening our leadership capacity to ensure colleagues have the support, clarity and conditions needed to develop and deliver strong business impact.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
This role combines people leadership and hands-on expertise.While you will have formal leadership responsibility, you are also expected to remain an active contributor and role model within your field, helping shape both delivery and capability development across the area.
You’ll lead, coach and develop a team of analysts and specialists while continuing to take ownership of hands-on work within your field. Depending on your experience and the needs of the area, this may include analytical problem-solving, delivery within a product or programme, capability development, stakeholder engagement, improving ways of working or supporting strategic initiatives.
You will:
Lead, coach and develop a team of analysts and specialists
Create clarity around priorities, expectations and development opportunities
Remain hands-on in your field of expertise and take ownership of relevant delivery, analytical work or strategic initiatives
Translate business needs and complex questions into clear analytical approaches, requirements and recommendations
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to strengthen data-informed decision-making
Drive adoption, stakeholder alignment and continuous improvement 
Support recruitment and the continued development of analytical capabilities across the are

WHO YOU ARE
You’re a collaborative leader and experienced analytics professional who enjoys combining people leadership with hands-on problem-solving. You thrive at the intersection of business, data and technology and can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery.
We believe you have:
A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience
Relevant experience in analytics, insights, data, business development or a related field
Leadership experience through people management or leading others through delivery and change
Experience translating business needs into analytical solutions and recommendations
Understanding of SQL and Power BI or similar visualisation tools.
A strong understanding of data governance, data quality and scalable reporting practices.
Strong stakeholder-management, communication and coaching skills
Experience working cross-functionally across business and technology
The ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery

Additional Information
This is a permanent, full-time position based in Stockholm. As collaboration and teamwork are important to us, we expect an in-office presence of four days per week.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.  
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group, we’re proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:
Global career and development opportunities
A value-driven culture where you’re encouraged to be yourself
Staff discount cards and benefits
Wellness and wellbeing benefits
Parental support
Opportunities to experiment, grow and create tangible impact in a large-scale organisation

Here, you’re encouraged to be yourself, experiment and grow. As you flourish, so do we.
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

description.text:
Company description:
How you’ll contribute
 As a Data Analyst with a Data Science mindset within the Project Management department of the Trucks Technology & Industrial division, your mission will go beyond traditional reporting. You will act as a data partner for project managers, helping them better understand, use, and trust data to support decision-making. You will contribute to building a data-driven culture, enabling teams to make insight-driven decisions. You will play a key role in transforming data into actionable insights, supporting project performance, optimized planning, risk anticipation, and strategic steering.
  
 Job description:Your key responsibilities: 
  Prepare, clean, and structure complex datasets to enable advanced analysis (Python, SQL) 
 Go beyond descriptive analytics by exploring data, identifying patterns, and generating insights that influence project decisions. Map existing elements to clearly identify and address the gaps critical to project success.
 Design and implement automated solutions to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency (RPA, Power Apps, Power Automate)
 Develop impactful dashboards and storytelling tools that support decision-making (Power BI)
 Partner with project managers to translate business questions into data use cases and actionable insights
 Act as a data evangelist, helping and training the Range teams to understand the value of data and adopt a data-driven mindset.
 Collaborate with Data Analysts and Data Scientists across the organization to align practices and leverage advanced analytics approaches
 Act as Product Owner for the tools you develop, secure a clear and complete documentation and description of the deliverables 
  Who are you? 
We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore, and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team.You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights, and supporting the development of others. 
 You like to connect the dots yourself rather than wait for the full picture, proactively reaching out to the people who hold the missing pieces. You bring a curious drive to challenge the status quo using data, with strong storytelling skills that influence non-technical stakeholders. You show genuine leadership potential through curiosity, initiative and the ability to bring others along, and you're committed in equal measure to your team's tasks and to the program's projects. You're an active listener, you collaborate well, and you're curious about project management processes and performance indicators. 
  Requirements: 
  You have a Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.  
 You have experience in the following:    Data analysis and visualization tools (Power BI or equivalent).  
 Programming and data manipulation skills using Python and SQL.  
 Understanding data modelling, statistical analysis, and business intelligence principles.  
 Knowledge of automation technologies, such as Power Automate, Power Apps, or RPA solutions.
 Strong documentation skills, with the ability to clearly describe processes and the work you've accomplished 
  
  
To qualify for the Graduate program, you: 
  Have completed a master’s degree prior to the start of the program but not more than 3 years ago.  
 Should not have more than three years' full-time relevant working experience in the field prior to starting, excluding part-time work during studies.  
 Are fluent in English, both written and verbal.   
 Are willing to travel and participate in international short-term assignments 
  What’s in it for you? 
Our Volvo Group Graduate Program starts in August 2027, and you will be offered a permanent position at Trucks Technology & Industrial Division with placement in Sweden, Gothenburg. These are some of the benefits of joining our program: 
 Read more about the Graduate program here
  An opportunity to work with the latest technology.
 An exciting and global working environment with experienced colleagues.
 Possibility to gain international experience through a short-term assignment abroad.
 A competitive salary and permanent position from day one.
 Various workshops and seminars designed to help you grow into your future career at Volvo Group.
 The possibility to shape your own career with endless career opportunities.

Company description:

How you’ll contribute

As a Data Analyst with a Data Science mindset within the Project Management department of the Trucks Technology & Industrial division, your mission will go beyond traditional reporting. You will act as a data partner for project managers, helping them better understand, use, and trust data to support decision-making. You will contribute to building a data-driven culture, enabling teams to make insight-driven decisions. You will play a key role in transforming data into actionable insights, supporting project performance, optimized planning, risk anticipation, and strategic steering.

 

Job description:

Your key responsibilities: 

  • Prepare, clean, and structure complex datasets to enable advanced analysis (Python, SQL) 
  • Go beyond descriptive analytics by exploring data, identifying patterns, and generating insights that influence project decisions. Map existing elements to clearly identify and address the gaps critical to project success.
  • Design and implement automated solutions to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency (RPA, Power Apps, Power Automate)
  • Develop impactful dashboards and storytelling tools that support decision-making (Power BI)
  • Partner with project managers to translate business questions into data use cases and actionable insights
  • Act as a data evangelist, helping and training the Range teams to understand the value of data and adopt a data-driven mindset.
  • Collaborate with Data Analysts and Data Scientists across the organization to align practices and leverage advanced analytics approaches
  • Act as Product Owner for the tools you develop, secure a clear and complete documentation and description of the deliverables 
Who are you?

We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore, and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team.You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights, and supporting the development of others. 

You like to connect the dots yourself rather than wait for the full picture, proactively reaching out to the people who hold the missing pieces. You bring a curious drive to challenge the status quo using data, with strong storytelling skills that influence non-technical stakeholders. You show genuine leadership potential through curiosity, initiative and the ability to bring others along, and you're committed in equal measure to your team's tasks and to the program's projects. You're an active listener, you collaborate well, and you're curious about project management processes and performance indicators. 

 Requirements: 

  • You have a Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.  
  • You have experience in the following:  
    • Data analysis and visualization tools (Power BI or equivalent).  
    • Programming and data manipulation skills using Python and SQL.  
    • Understanding data modelling, statistical analysis, and business intelligence principles.  
    • Knowledge of automation technologies, such as Power Automate, Power Apps, or RPA solutions.
    • Strong documentation skills, with the ability to clearly describe processes and the work you've accomplished 

To qualify for the Graduate program, you: 

  • Have completed a master’s degree prior to the start of the program but not more than 3 years ago.  
  • Should not have more than three years' full-time relevant working experience in the field prior to starting, excluding part-time work during studies.  
  • Are fluent in English, both written and verbal.   
  • Are willing to travel and participate in international short-term assignments 
What’s in it for you?

Our Volvo Group Graduate Program starts in August 2027, and you will be offered a permanent position at Trucks Technology & Industrial Division with placement in Sweden, Gothenburg. These are some of the benefits of joining our program: 

Read more about the Graduate program here

  • An opportunity to work with the latest technology.
  • An exciting and global working environment with experienced colleagues.
  • Possibility to gain international experience through a short-term assignment abroad.
  • A competitive salary and permanent position from day one.
  • Various workshops and seminars designed to help you grow into your future career at Volvo Group.
  • The possibility to shape your own career with endless career opportunities. 
The application process

The journey begins! An email confirmation will be sent when you submit your application. After this, it is still possible to update your personal profile by logging into your account. The hiring team will review your application together with the hiring manager. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with information about the following steps.

description.text:
Vår kund brinner för att hjälpa företagare att lyckas genom innovativa lösningar. Här får du chansen att förvandla digitalt brus till värdefulla insikter och forma framtidens datadrivna landskap i en dynamisk miljö.
Om tjänsten
I rollen som Analytics Engineer hamnar du i navet mellan teknik och affär. Du ansvarar för att städa upp i det digitala bruset och bygga de broar som krävs för att förvandla rådata till insikter som verkligen räknas.
Du erbjuds
Möjlighet att forma det datadrivna landskapet: Du får en nyckelroll i navet mellan teknik och affär där du bygger datamodeller och pipelines (med verktyg som dbt) som förvandlar rådata till konkreta affärsinsikter.
En innovativ och uppskattad arbetsmiljö: Du blir en del av ett engagerat team i en dynamisk miljö där din kunskap inom datamodellering värderas högt och där du uppmuntras att driva best practices.
Rätta förutsättningar att växa: Du erbjuds en utvecklande konsultroll på heltid i Malmö med start ASAP, där du får stort eget ansvar att säkra datakvalitet och bygga broar mellan teknik och verksamhet.

Arbetsuppgifter
Rollen innebär att ansvara för datamodellering och arkitektur för att omvandla rådata till strukturerade insikter som stödjer affärsbeslut genom hela organisationen.
Förvandla komplex rådata till smarta och strukturerade datamodeller  
Utveckla och optimera centrala dataflöden med dbt som huvudverktyg  
Säkerställa att data är tillförlitlig, jämförbar och av högsta kvalitet  
Agera brygga mellan Data Engineers och verksamhetens olika analytiker  
Driva och sätta standarder för best practices inom datamodellering  
Implementera gemensamma definitioner för att säkra datans affärsvärde  
Säkerställa att kärnmodellerna möter organisationens långsiktiga behov

Vi söker dig som
Erfarenhet av rollen som Analytics Engineer, BI-utvecklare eller liknande
Avancerad kunskap i datamodellering med verktyg som dbt
Förmåga att uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska
Erfarenhet av att arbeta självständigt i en snabbrörlig miljö

Det är meriterande om du har
Gedigna kunskaper i SQL
Erfarenhet av BigQuery eller andra molnbaserade datalager
Erfarenhet av BI-verktyg som Looker, Qlik, Power BI eller Tableau

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:
Förändringsbenägen
Hjälpsam
Social
Ordningsam
Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

description.text:
Job Description
As a Lead Data Analyst focused on Analytics engineering, you will play a key role in raising the analytical and technical maturity of our Data Analysts by establishing standards, providing hands-on guidance and enabling analysts to build robust and scalable data products.  
You will lead the development and adoption of Analytics Engineering practices across the organization, helping teams improve how data is modeled, governed, and consumed. Through upskilling, knowledge sharing, and creation of reusable frameworks and assets, you will strengthen our analytics capabilities and help establish a more consistent way of working with data.  
The role requires a high degree of autonomy, initiative taking, and collaboration. You will proactively identify opportunities to improve data practices, drive cross-functional initiatives, and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Success in this role depends on your ability to balance strategic priorities with execution, navigate a complex organization and data landscape, and help teams deliver analytical solutions that are scalable, maintainable and aligned with business needs.  


WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead complex analytical initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and data exploration to data modeling, analysis and actionable recommendations. 
Partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate strategic questions and business needs into analytical approaches, scalable data models, and actionable insights. 
Lead the development of reusable data assets, templates, and frameworks that streamline work and promote scalability. 
Champion best practices in Analytics Engineering through the data analytics community, including data modeling, testing, documentation and maintainability of analytical data products, ensuring the support both traditional analytics and emerging AI driven use cases. 
Own and drive the Analytics Engineering community for Data Analysts, establishing standards and fostering collaboration across the organization.  
Design and deliver training sessions, workshops, and documentation to upskill colleagues in tools, methodologies, and data interpretation. 
Proactively identify and act on opportunities to improve data literacy and analytical capabilities across the organization. 
Mentor colleagues and contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 



WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with...
Proven experience leading complex analytical initiatives and influencing analytical direction across teams or domains. 
Strong business understanding and ability to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into clear analytical questions, approaches, and recommendations. 
Experience driving standards, best practices, and ways of working across teams through influence, coaching, and collaboration. 
Proven experience mentoring and developing colleagues through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
High proficiency in SQL and strong understanding of data modeling principles. 
Experience developing and maintaining analytical data products using tools such as dbt, Power Query, or similar. 
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and modern analytics architectures. 
Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices within analytics workflows. 
Experience using Python, R, or similar technologies to support analytical workflows and automation. 
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 



WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
We offer all our employee’s attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 
30 days holiday 
We offer a collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance
H&M Incentive Program
Wellness benefit 4000kr/year
Benifex Benefits Portal
Community with activities 



JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things, our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Experience with master data, product data and data quality in PIM/MDM environments

Excellent documentation skills and fluency in spoken and written English

Experience with STEP (Stibo Systems)
Experience with Snowflake or Databricks
Background in the aftermarket or parts and accessories space, such as product compatibility, installed base or spare parts

Ability to start at short notice

description.text:
Nordnet is redefining the landscape of savings and investments, guiding over 2.5 million customers in their financial lives. We have spent the last years building a modern data platform and fostering a culture where actionable insights and rapid product refinement are part of our DNA. In our fast-paced environment, this remains a competitive edge - allowing us to ship, learn, and iterate faster than the market.
Now we are seeking to engage a passionate Data Analyst to join our team.
The role
As a Data Analyst at Nordnet, you will be a part of Data & Insights, where you have the opportunity to work alongside Data analysts, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.
You will be embedded in our Product development teams, where you will be an integral component, working with designers, product leads and developers. You will deep-dive into our users and our products, and turn data into actionable insights.
We would love it if you feel excited about at least some of these statements.

Going beyond simple questions, defining a problem and understanding the right analytical approach


Conduct statistical analyses on our customer -, financial -, and company data to identify patterns of behaviour


Design experiments to evaluate various hypotheses and design choices


Utilize AI and advanced modeling to scale your impact


Craft and present compelling stories that will impact our decision makers


Help improve our existing methodologies

This is you
You are passionate about data and learning new things, and you want to contribute with your experience and ideas. In your work, you are organised, methodical and agile in a way that benefits the team’s working climate and ability to deliver solutions.
To thrive in this role, we believe that most of these criteria describe you:

Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership


A strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Experience of using SQL, Python, R and dbt


Hands-on experience with A/B testing


Degree in economics, data science, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or similar


 We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Analyst at a product oriented organisation.
What we offer
We are committed to your continuous growth, offering a space where you can learn, contribute, and take ownership of your technical domain over time. At Nordnet, we offer:

A hybrid work model balancing remote flexibility with collaboration in our Stockholm office.


5,000 SEK annual wellness contribution (friskvårdsbidrag).


A culture that values continuous learning and technical ownership.


Visit us on www.nordnetab.com,www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.
Application
At Nordnet, we know that the best products are built by teams with a mix of different backgrounds and perspectives. If you are excited about the challenges we’re solving and see yourself contributing to our team culture, we’d love to hear from you.
To ensure a fair and streamlined process for everyone, we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We interview continuously, so feel free to reach out as soon as possible!
Please note: Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate as part of our standard process for a digital bank.
We look forward to meeting you!

About Hotmat.se
Hotmat.se is a growing Swedish food delivery company that partners with restaurants across Sweden. We develop and maintain our own digital platforms and are looking for a Data Analyst to help us understand our business better and make smarter, faster decisions.


Job Description
As a Data Analyst at Hotmat.se, you will be responsible for turning our order, delivery, and customer data into clear insights that support the business. You will work closely with our leadership and development team to build reporting that helps us track performance, spot problems early, and grow more efficiently.


Responsibilities
Analyze order, delivery, and customer data to identify trends and issues
Clean, structure, and prepare data from multiple sources (orders, deliveries, payments, customer feedback) to ensure quality and consistency
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using visualization tools
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract data from our databases
Use Python and pandas for deeper analysis on larger datasets
Present findings in a clear, actionable way to non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with the development team on data collection and quality


Required Skills
SQL
Python and pandas
Excel
Data cleaning and preparation
Data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar)


Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who is:


Passionate about data and turning numbers into decisions
Self-motivated and proactive
Detail-oriented and quality-focused
A strong problem solver
Able to work independently as well as part of a team


What We Offer
Opportunity to shape how a growing company uses data, from the ground up
A growing and innovative company
Flexible working environment
Exciting technical challenges


Location
Gothenburg office


Employment Type
Full-time, permanent position with an initial probationary period.


How to Apply
Please send your CV and, if available, examples of past analysis or dashboards, to jobb@hotmat.se

description.text:
Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone’s contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business.
As Analytics Engineer at our Stockholm Head Office, you will transform clean, validated data into well-documented, trusted datasets that teams across Acne Studios rely on. Your work enables self-service analytics through Power BI and other consumption layers, so that business users can find and use data without ad-hoc engineering support. You succeed when datasets are accurate and trusted, and when metrics are consistent across the company. To get there, you build strong relationships with stakeholders, communicate clearly, deliver reliably and share your knowledge with the team.
CULTURE OF COLLABORATION
We firmly believe that when you feel supported, included, and trusted, it enables you to enjoy your work and thrive in it. You will be a part of a team of colleagues with diverse roles and backgrounds, each with their unique skills and experiences.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
As Analytics Engineer your main contribution will be to build the data foundation that turns raw, validated data into business-ready models used across the company. You will report to Manager Data Insights. You will play a vital role in making data accessible, reliable and consistent for everyone at Acne Studios by:
Designing and maintaining dimensional models (facts, dimensions, lookups) in the gold layer, following star schema principles
Building and operating reusable data transformation pipelines using PySpark and SQL on Databricks
Structuring and exposing data for consumption by Power BI and external systems such as Centric and Dema
Contributing to building a centralized semantic layer in Databricks
Implementing and maintaining core business metrics, logic and KPIs
Ensuring data quality through automated testing and validation
Documenting datasets and making them easy to find and use
Partnering with stakeholders to translate business needs into requirements and data models
Supporting analysts working in Power BI and Databricks Dashboards with clear and structured guidance
Communicating proactively with business users about what data is available, what it means and how to use it
Contributing to improvements in transformation patterns, testing frameworks, tools and ways of working

WHO YOU ARE
You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. You enjoy working as a team and you embrace feedback to develop yourself and others. You are curious and thrive in a dynamic environment. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow. If these qualities speak to you, we would love to have you on our team.
Specific personal qualities for this role:
Clear communicator with both technical and business audiences
Service-minded and responsive
Structured and detail-oriented, with high standards for accuracy and documentation
Proactive in identifying improvements
Curious and motivated to keep learning
Team player who shares knowledge through code reviews, demos and presentations

Specific experience and knowledge for this role:
Strong dimensional modelling skills (star schema, SCD2 etc.)
Advanced PySpark and SQL (window functions, complex joins, incremental processing)
Experience working with Spark
Solid Python skills (data validation, scripting, testing)
Experience with the Databricks platform: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, notebooks, jobs, workflows
Experience with orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Data Factory or similar)
Familiarity with Power BI (semantic models, relationships, DAX basics)
Familiarity with AI-assisted Lakehouse tools (code assistants, Genie spaces, AI/BI dashboards, model serving endpoints)
Familiarity with CI/CD for data assets (Databricks Asset Bundles, Git integration)
Familiarity with data quality frameworks (Great Expectations or custom assertion patterns)
Fluent in English

What matters most to us is not whether you master all the listed knowledge and skills. We are dedicated to recognising the potential in each individual. We embrace diversity of people as well as ideas and viewpoints and encourage everyone's individual expression of their own identity.

description.text:
På Synsam har vi en modern dataplattform, en stor nordisk verksamhet och många intressanta problem att lösa. Vi är ett litet Analytics-team, som ingår i Synsams IT-avdelning, där du får stort utrymme att påverka både vad vi bygger och hur vi arbetar. Vi har olika kompetenser, men hjälps åt och arbetar över gränserna när det behövs.
Vi söker en Senior Analytics Engineer som vill vidareutveckla vår dataplattform, modernisera befintliga lösningar och testa nya idéer. Här får du ta ansvar för hur plattformen utvecklas och se hur lösningarna används i verksamheten.
Om rollen
Du kommer att arbeta med dataintegration, datamodellering och utveckling i Snowflake och dbt. Vi har flera källsystem och dataflöden som behöver utvecklas, kvalitetssäkras och moderniseras. 
En viktig del av arbetet är att bygga tillförlitliga och återanvändbara datamodeller med tydliga affärsdefinitioner, automatiserade tester, övervakning och behörighetsstyrning. Målet är att data ska kunna användas på ett konsekvent sätt i Qlik, AI-baserade lösningar och andra applikationer. 
Du samarbetar med verksamheten och andra delar av IT för att förstå behoven och hitta rätt lösningar. Tillsammans arbetar vi också för att verksamheten ska ta ett tydligare ägarskap för sina datadomäner och affärsdefinitioner. 
Rollen omfattar både nyutveckling och modernisering av befintliga lösningar, men även en del förvaltning och support. Du får möjlighet att påverka arkitektur, tekniska beslut och hur vi bygger en plattform som är enkel att vidareutveckla och förvalta.
Efter 12–18 månader har du till exempel:
moderniserat och flyttat flera av våra dataflöden och analyslösningar till den gemensamma dataplattformen


infört automatiserade tester, övervakning och behörighetsstyrning för våra viktigaste dataflöden


tagit fram gemensamma definitioner för våra viktigaste nyckeltal tillsammans med verksamheten, så att de kan återanvändas i Qlik, analyser och AI-baserade lösningar


förenklat utveckling och förvaltning genom bättre arbetssätt och automatisering

Vem söker vi?
Vi tror att du har:

Flerårig erfarenhet av att driva arkitektur- och designbeslut och/eller att ta tekniskt ansvar för en plattform.


Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och datamodellering.


Erfarenhet av moderna dataplattformar i molnet, gärna Snowflake.


Erfarenhet av dbt eller liknande arbetssätt för datatransformation.


Erfarenhet av dataintegration, datakvalitet, testning, övervakning och optimering.


Erfarenhet av Git och versionshanterad utveckling.


Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med både verksamheten och andra tekniska team.


Erfarenhet från en prenumerations- eller abonnemangsbaserad verksamhet är meriterande. 
Du behöver inte kunna alla våra verktyg från början. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, tycker om att förstå hur saker hänger ihop och gärna går till botten med problem. Du ser helheten i dataflöden, modeller och arkitektur, vågar utmana befintliga lösningar och kan diskutera tekniska frågor med både verksamheten och andra utvecklare.
Känner du igen dig i rollen men uppfyller inte alla krav? Sök ändå. Vi är mer intresserade av hur du tänker och vad du kan bidra med än av att du bockar av varje punkt.
Hur vi arbetar
AI är en naturlig del av vårt arbete. Vi använder bland annat Snowflake Cortex Code, ChatGPT och Claude Code för att utveckla, analysera och automatisera. Vi testar nya verktyg och arbetssätt och väljer det som passar uppgiften bäst. 
Vi delar kunskap och förbättrar våra arbetssätt tillsammans. Det viktiga är inte vilket verktyg vi använder, utan kvaliteten på det vi bygger och vad vi åstadkommer.
Vår huvudsakliga teknikmiljö består idag av Snowflake, dbt, Qlik Cloud och Fivetran.
Om rekryteringsprocessen
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning och utgår från Synsams huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm.
I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat. För anställning krävs att du har giltig rätt att arbeta i Sverige i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning. Urval sker löpande och vi ser fram emot din ansökan redan idag!
Om Synsam
Synsam Group är en ledande optikerkedja i Norden med ett brett och prisvärt abonnemangs-erbjudande. Synsam Group erbjuder ett brett sortiment av produkter och tjänster för ögonhälsa och ögonmode utifrån kundens olika livsstilar och behov. Koncernen har cirka 4 000 medarbetare, en omsättning på cirka 7,1 miljarder SEK (2025) och har cirka 600 butiker i Norden som drivs under varumärkena Synsam, Synsam Outlet samt Profil Optik i Danmark. Genom digitalisering, abonnemangserbjudanden och andra innovativa koncept är Synsam Group en stark innovatör på den nordiska optikmarknaden inom flera områden, inklusive kundresa, produkterbjudande och ESG. Synsam Groups aktie handlas på Nasdaq Stockholm (SYNSAM). www.synsam.com

description.text:
Analytics Engineer
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time 
The Role:
As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.


Who you are:
A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.



Qualifications 
We are looking for someone with:
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.



Nice to have:
Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.



What you will do:
You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:
Data Modeling & Quality: Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.



What we offer:
The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.



Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
Deutschlandticket
Wellpass



About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
  • Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
  • Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.


What we offer:

  • The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
  • Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
  • Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
  • A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
  • Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
  • Mental health & parental support offerings
  • 30 days of paid vacation.


Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:

  • 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
  • Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:

  • Deutschlandticket
  • Wellpass


About us

Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us

You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today

This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.

Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.
